messages:
Mike: Quick check — planning to deprecate the embeddings API param `strict_mode` and introduce a request header `x-embed-mode: permissive|strict`. Thoughts on how this should affect empty/null items and truncation behavior?
Sara: Agree this needs to be explicit. Backcompat is key: if header is absent we should default to permissive for at least one release cycle.
Lee: TL;DR: permissive = current behavior (coerce single strings, coerce null -> '' -> vector), strict = fail/mark per-item.
Anita: Slight nuance: some clients rely on nulls being skipped (no output slot). Runtime currently turns null -> '' which returns a vector. If strict will return null, we need to signal that in the response shape.
Mike: Proposal: keep server default = permissive. Add header `x-embed-mode`. In `strict` mode, server will not coerce nulls -> '' and will instead return a per-item status. In permissive, preserve existing coercion.
Lee: Also for truncation: currently we silently truncate inputs > 512 tokens and still return a vector. In strict mode we should surface a per-item warning or status (e.g., `truncated`). Not a hard error.
Sara: I like per-item status instead of global failing. Example response schema we can document:
```json
[{
  "input": "...original input...",
  "embedding": [0.001, -0.23, ...] or null,
  "status": "ok" | "null" | "truncated",
  "warnings": ["truncated to 512 tokens"]
}]
```
Mike: And curl example to opt into strict: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "x-embed-mode: strict" ...`
Anita: Tests: unit tests for null vs empty string, integration test that verifies SDKs get the per-item shape. Also need a migration note for JS/Python SDKs (they currently assume array-of-vectors length == inputs.length).
Lee: Implementation detail: runtime will return `embedding: null` for null inputs in strict mode. For permissive, embedding always returns a vector (coerced).
Sara: Ops: plan a canary rollout and a feature flag `embed_strict_mode` so we can flip behavior per-customer. Also add a metric `embed.strict_mode.request_count` and `embed.per_item_status.truncated` to monitor regressions.
deploy-bot: Canary job `eng-embeds-canary` scheduled at 2026-03-20T17:30:00Z — will run against a small subset of traffic.
Mike: I'll open a PR with API docs + CRD for the header and add the response schema. Will ping SDK owners @Sara @Lee for updates. Plan: default permissive for 2 releases, warn about deprecation in docs.
Anita: +1. Also add SDK helper that maps `null` embedding -> None / null in language idiomatic way and surface warnings list.
Lee: One more thought: add a deprecation header in responses when `strict_mode` param is present but ignored: `Warning: strict_mode deprecated; use x-embed-mode`.
Mike: Good call. I'll add that to the spec. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Sara: I'll add integration test cases to the embed test matrix (:eyes:).
Anita: Filing a follow-up ticket for docs and SDK examples.
Mike: Cool — CR will reference ticket ENG-embed-452. Ping me for review.
